title: Tenure Extension on Reissued Certificates (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus)
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** A tenure extension is added to the validity of a certificate reissued after a return, according to the tier held and the full calendar months the membership has been enrolled, counted from its enrollment date.

**Rule.** A membership on a paid tier (Tailwise Plus Monthly, Tailwise Plus Annual or Tailwise Plus Premier Annual) and enrolled for at least 60 months: 6 days. A membership that does not meet both of those conditions but is enrolled for at least 24 months: 3 days. Any other membership: no tenure extension.

| Tier held | Months enrolled | Tenure extension |
|---|---|---|
| a paid tier | 60 or more | 6 days |
| a paid tier | 24 to 59 | 3 days |
| a free tier | 24 or more (including 60 or more) | 3 days |
| any tier | fewer than 24 | none |

**Example (hypothetical).** A Pals Rewards VIP member enrolled 70 months: 3 days — the months are there but the tier is not a paid tier.
